pack_fp4_to_uint8: pack a PyTorch tensor of float values into FP4 E2M1 format stored as uint8 by finding closest quantized values
unpack_fp4_from_uint8: unpack a uint8 tensor containing packed FP4 E2M1 values back into a dense PyTorch tensor with specified dtype
cast_to_fp4: quantize a PyTorch tensor by rounding each element to the nearest valid FP4 E2M1 value using threshold-based binning
get_e2m1_tensor: get or create a device-specific cached lookup tensor containing the eight FP4 E2M1 quantization values for a given device
review_fp4_quantization: review the FP4 E2M1 quantization utilities including pack, unpack, and cast functions for vLLM extension usage
